Now record content assessment: need global_summary=true once for whole deck, and per-page. I already have content evidence id 6d8a4cca... covering all 6 pages. Let me record content with global_summary true covering all pages, with issues? Check facts: all numbers correct. Section names in titles ✓。One note: cover says "汇报日期 待补充" — acceptable. Cover's "本册说明" says "资料未给出的排期、预算、认证与经营成果，一律不写入" — consistent.

Content: page 2 "客户问题" — the source doesn't describe customer problems; page honestly frames as 已明确/待确认. Acceptable.

I'll record content global summary with no issues. Maybe record as a single record with global_summary=true and page_ids all 6.

Then fix the two improvements, then re-inspect changed pages (steps, scope visual) and recheck content globally (since content unaffected... but instructions: 修改后重查改动页并复核全稿内容). Content changes only in visual styling, so I could record content again after revisions? The requirement: "须有当前全稿内容检查" — the revision changes ID, so content check tied to old revision may be invalid. Safer: after revisions, re-inspect content for all pages and record content again with global_summary=true.

Plan: record content now (global true), revise steps, revise scope, then inspect content (all) + visual (steps, scope), record visual for those two, record content again global.

That's a few calls but fine. Actually I could skip recording content now and do it after revisions to save calls. Better: do revisions first, then record content once after. But record_assessment content needs current revision evidence. Let me just revise first, then inspect content all + visual steps/scope, then record both.

Wait — but improvements are optional; fixing them requires extra rework. It's within limits (1 rework each). Let's do it for quality where readability matters (scope overlap). Steps accent inconsistency also easy.

Do both revisions in parallel.
